resume: Physically modelled electric piano, vibraphone and marimba, no samples: six instrument types, a stage-keyboard effects chain, an arpeggiator, a sequencer, scales and 10 voices. The screen shows one page at a time, with four cards for the four knobs.

commandes.role: Turns all effects off or on.
Acts as HOLD for the arpeggiator, on all pages, while it is lit.
Opens the PERFORM page (drive, filter, delay, reverb, or whatever is assigned); two presses open the main FRODHES page.
Sequencer; on its page, records, and held erases.
Sets the tempo by tapping, everywhere except the SEQUENCER page where it starts and stops; during the arpeggiator, it also taps the tempo.

modes.texte: Stage 77, Suitcase, Early Felt, Bell Dyno (electric pianos), Vibes and Marimba. Knobs K1 to K4 set the four cards of the displayed page.

a_savoir: The FM-1 key velocity is set in SETUP, TOUCH: LIGHT, MEDIUM, HEAVY or FIXED.
